d: When the heatwave hits, Maya and friends find cool, clever and refreshing ways to make the most of summer.
From broken shells to runaway balls, join Maya and friends as everyday play turns into hilarious meadow mayhem.
Get ready to giggle! This collection gathers the silliest, most laugh-out-loud moments in the meadow.
Lovable, lazy and always hungry, Willy takes centre stage in a collection full of his funniest moments.
Whenever someone's in trouble, Maya is first to help — proving that kindness is the meadow's greatest superpower.
Sweet treasures and tasty treats are best when shared — Maya teaches the meadow the joy of giving.
Beetles, snails and spiders — Maya discovers that even the smallest creatures have the biggest hearts.
